{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Compute mean revenue including all completed orders (including QA)
mean_revenue_incl_qa = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (including QA): {mean_revenue_incl_qa:.2f}")

# Print the number of completed orders
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}")

# Print the number of QA orders
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")"}
